scenes.basis: 4:1 "was led by the Spirit into the wilderness"; 4:2 "He ate nothing in those days"
4:5 "The devil, leading him up on a high mountain" - the mountain of the kingdoms is not named
4:9 "He led him to Jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple"
4:14 "Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee"
4:16 "He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up"
4:31 "He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee"
4:38 "He rose up from the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house" - the house is in Capernaum (4:31-37), which Luke does not repeat
4:44 "He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee"
